other_errors.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [74] said several of these matters were read only through drafts or unsigned papers; the agent wrote them as executed or operative.

divergence: All three runs fail on the precision criterion in the same way: each wrote matters resting on drafts, blank-dated or withdrawn packages, or unrelated fee papers as offset or waiver precedents, and the reviews flagged the drafts specifically in every run (T1 relabelled them across five agent-declared check stages without removing them). They differ on the fourth needed matter, a co-invest vehicle: T1 found it through a path search and read its executed agreement in its first reads; T0 dropped it when shortlisting from scan snippets and never opened it; T2 listed its files but never read them and excluded it. So the split for that matter is the first reading choice after it surfaced; the reviews flagged only the unopened number series in T0 and nothing in T2. Label notes played no role; T1's declared new stages were all post-write checks.
